project_type: Node.js/Express backend (backend/) + Next.js 14 frontend + Expo mobile in one repository (halqavoice-club/HALQA1); this task touches only backend, docs, and prisma migrations
build_system: npm; backend runs from backend/; node_modules already installed (jest, @prisma/client present). No compile step — node --check is the syntax gate for JS.
test_framework: Jest 29 with a custom test-safety launcher. CRITICAL: backend/test-safety/safe-test-manifest.js classifies EVERY file under backend/src/tests/ — any new test file MUST be added to SAFE_UNIT_TESTS or DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS (integration/real-db files go in DESTRUCTIVE_TESTS) in the same commit, otherwise 'unclassified test file' aborts all unit runs. Unit mode (node test-safety/run-jest.js) strips DATABASE_URL from env and blocks 'new PrismaClient' via prisma-client-unit-guard.setup.js. Integration mode (npm run test:integration -> test-safety/run-integration.js) requires DATABASE_URL in env and uses jest.integration.config.js (roots src/tests/integration, testMatch **/*.integration.test.js, runInBand, 60s timeout).
build_command: cd backend; node --check <file> for touched JS files; npm run test:unit (safe manifest); npx prisma generate only if schema.prisma changes (it must NOT change in this task)
test_command: cd backend; node test-safety/run-jest.js src/tests/live-class-microphone-unit-a.test.js (focused unit); npm run test:unit (full safe suite); $env:DATABASE_URL='mysql://root@localhost:3306/halqa_test'; npm run test:integration -- src/tests/integration/<file>.integration.test.js (per-file integration)
verification_instructions: 1) Unit: from backend/ run 'npm run test:unit' — must pass with zero failures. 2) Integration: first create the disposable DB once: & 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe' -uroot -e 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS halqa_test; CREATE DATABASE halqa_test CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;' then $env:DATABASE_URL='mysql://root@localhost:3306/halqa_test'; npx prisma migrate deploy (applies all migrations including new ones). Then set $env:NODE_ENV='test'; $env:JWT_SECRET='ci_integration_jwt_secret_at_least_32_characters!!'; $env:JWT_REFRESH_SECRET='ci_integration_refresh_secret_32_chars!!'; $env:PORT='5002' and run npm run test:integration -- <specific file>. 3) Migration state queries via mysql.exe CLI (information_schema.triggers, SHOW COLUMNS). 4) git diff --stat must show backend/prisma/migrations/20261030_fix_live_class_microphone_triggers/migration.sql untouched; SHA-256 of that file must remain 4fc783645ef9efbe181412e5abe32f3174a746ab9e1d585209ce26408c71cc80 (PowerShell: (Get-FileHash <path> -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()).
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell; repo root path contains spaces — always quote. Local DB is XAMPP MariaDB 10.4.32 (root, empty password) at 127.0.0.1:3306, CLI at C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysql.exe; dev DB is halqa_db (DO NOT run destructive/integration tests against it — they create and delete rows; use the disposable halqa_test). No Docker available locally — the design's docker-based 10.11 rehearsal must be performed against the disposable halqa_test on 10.4; GitHub Actions CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, job 'Backend -- Integration Tests (MariaDB 10.11)') is the authoritative 10.11 gate once pushed. gh CLI v2.102 is authenticated as account halqavoice-club with repo scope. Repository has labels: bug, documentation, enhancement, duplicate, good first issue, help wanted, question, invalid, wontfix, dependencies, javascript — no P1/P2 labels exist, so priorities go in issue titles. Commit locally on branch main; NEVER push. Unit-mode jest setup deletes DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL, so unit tests must never connect to a DB. In unit tests, mock '../utils/prisma' with jest.mock (the controller-internal rawFindLiveClass/rawUpdateLiveClassStatus cannot be mocked — they are module-local closures over the prisma singleton; mocking the ../utils/prisma module is the only feasible dispatch-test mechanism).
contribution_requirements: Backend tests must be classified in test-safety/safe-test-manifest.js. Never edit historical migrations 20261029/20261030 (checksum 4fc783645ef9efbe181412e5abe32f3174a746ab9e1d585209ce26408c71cc80). New migrations must sort lexicographically after 20261114_add_post_report_pending_unique. No production behavior changes in the test-hygiene work (FEAT-003). The 409 response body must not contain SQLSTATE, 45000, trigger names, or raw SQL. Push scope: none — commit locally only; the workflow's merge step handles the remote.
key_patterns: Raw SQL via prisma.$executeRawUnsafe / $queryRawUnsafe with ? placeholders; helpers build column lists with conditional strings keeping literal '1,1,0,0' inline for screenShare/whiteboard/quranPanel/isRecorded; self-contained PrismaClient in beforeAll for integration tests (never import utils/prisma singleton there); errorResponse(res, message, statusCode) from backend/src/utils/response.js; controller imports contract utils from ../utils/liveClassMicrophoneContract (already imports MICROPHONE_AUTHORIZATION_MODES at line 9); unit test file backend/src/tests/live-class-microphone-unit-a.test.js reads controller source as text and also runs real assertions — extend it, do not create a new unit file. Integration test naming: <topic>.integration.test.js in backend/src/tests/integration/.
relevant_files: backend/src/tests/live-class-real-db.test.js (modify: createTestLC ~88-122, ~12 call sites; identity constants lines 43-51)
directory_structure: backend/src/controllers (one file per domain), backend/src/utils (shared helpers incl. liveClassMicrophoneContract.js), backend/src/tests (top-level: unit + real-db files), backend/src/tests/integration (*.integration.test.js), backend/prisma/migrations (timestamped dirs, one migration.sql each), backend/test-safety (jest launchers + safe-test-manifest.js), docs/live-class (per-domain docs). GitHub issues live on halqavoice-club/HALQA1.
